newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Q4 traffic strong, fuel costs up.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Q4 traffic strong, fuel costs up.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said Thursday that October traffic has been very strong and that bookings for the remainder of the fourth quarter are thus far strong.
However, the company also said higher fuel costs and the reimposition of the federal ticket tax, which affected third quarter earnings, will also affect fourth quarter earnings.
On Thursday the company reported that third quarter earnings had falled to $0.40 per share from the year-ago figure of $0.45. First Call consensus estimate for the quarter was $0.38 per share.
